clientIPDetection.description: Explicit original-client-IP mode required by per-client rate-limit selectors; the empty default is deliberately not deployable.

rateLimit.description: Fixed partial local per-source-IP limit retained from ingress; no burst parameter is exposed by the pinned Envoy Gateway policy API.

limit.description: Maximum request body size for the isolated API HTTPRoute; fixed to the retained 50 MiB ingress contract.
